items.title: Urban Biodiversity Corridors
items.audioTranscript: City planners are incorporating ecological corridors to allow wildlife species to migrate safely across modern highways. These green bridges reduce vehicle collisions and promote genetic diversity among isolated populations.

items.audioTranscript: Geothermal power plants extract superheated steam from deep subterranean reservoirs to drive turbines and produce clean electricity. This constant renewable resource remains unaffected by surface weather conditions.

items.title: Marine Biology and Coral Bleaching
items.audioTranscript: Elevated sea temperatures disrupt the delicate symbiosis between corals and their photosynthetic microalgae. Without these symbiotic organisms, coral reefs lose their vibrant pigmentation and struggle to survive.
